name: Camarillo Premium Outlets
demographics: Camarillo Premium Outlets attracts a diverse mix of value-conscious shoppers and tourists, with a strong representation of middle to upper-middle income families from Ventura County and the greater Los Angeles area. The center draws visitors aged 25-65, including young professionals and families seeking designer brands at discounted prices. The trade area extends from nearby coastal communities like Oxnard and Ventura to inland areas, with significant weekend traffic from Los Angeles County residents making day trips along the 101 corridor. Shoppers typically exhibit deal-seeking behavior and brand loyalty, often planning extended visits to maximize savings across multiple outlet stores.
description: Camarillo Premium Outlets stands as one of Southern California's premier outlet shopping destinations, strategically located along the Ventura Boulevard corridor in Camarillo. As part of the renowned Premium Outlets collection, this open-air shopping center offers an exceptional retail experience featuring designer and name-brand merchandise at savings of 25% to 65% every day. The center has established itself as a regional draw for savvy shoppers seeking luxury and contemporary brands at outlet prices, conveniently positioned between Los Angeles and Santa Barbara along the scenic Highway 101. With its Mediterranean-inspired architecture and well-maintained outdoor walkways, the center provides a pleasant shopping environment year-round, taking advantage of Camarillo's mild coastal climate. The outlet's strong reputation is reflected in its impressive 4.5-star rating from nearly 13,000 reviews, demonstrating consistent customer satisfaction and its status as a must-visit destination for both locals and tourists exploring California's Central Coast.
summary: Camarillo Premium Outlets is a highly-rated outlet shopping destination on Ventura Boulevard, offering designer and name-brand merchandise at significant discounts in an attractive open-air setting. With nearly 13,000 customer reviews and a 4.5-star rating, it serves as a major retail draw for the Ventura County region and visitors traveling between Los Angeles and Santa Barbara.
